description: Saves still images from a video with ffmpeg on this machine: one every N seconds, a set number spread over the clip, one at each scene change, or every frame (at most 500). Files are PNG, JPG or WebP named by their time (name-00m02s000.png), in a folder next to the video. Needs ffmpeg installed.

mode.description: interval: every `every` seconds; count: `count` frames spread evenly; scenes: the first frame of each shot; all: every frame

overwrite.description: Replace frames with the same names

sensitivity.description: Scene detection, higher finds smaller changes (default 50)

name: video_frames
title: Frames from a video
